info.name: Reqres API Testing Portfolio
info.description: API testing portfolio collection for the Reqres Demo API. This collection is organized to demonstrate smoke testing, positive scenarios, negative scenarios, boundary testing, contract testing, regression testing and basic response time observation. Requests should use the Reqres API Environment and reusable variables such as {{baseUrl}}, {{validUserId}}, {{validEmail}} and {{validPassword}}.

item.description:
Contains user listing requests used to validate pagination, custom page size, JSON response structure and list-user contracts.

This folder covers positive and functional scenarios for retrieving user lists from different pages and with custom pagination parameters.

These requests validate HTTP status codes, JSON Content-Type, pagination fields, integer value constraints, data array structure and absence of internal implementation details.

item.name: 03 - Users - Single User
item.description:
Contains requests for retrieving individual users by ID, including successful retrieval and not found behavior.

This folder covers positive and negative scenarios for single user lookup using valid and invalid user IDs.

These requests validate HTTP status codes, JSON Content-Type, user response contracts, support object structure, not found behavior, absence of success payload in error responses and absence of internal implementation details.

- Response does not expose internal implementation details
